name: parameter-video-tool
description: A parameter-driven exercise video editor, driven by cue timelines or live input from the Stickies algorithms.

scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:bridge && npm run test:e2e
scripts.setup:stickies: git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/kaithesavior/Video-Sticky-Algorithms.git vendor/Video-Sticky-Algorithms && python3 -m pip install -r stickies_bridge/requirements.txt
